findings.summary: Connections policy controls are static and cannot submit bulk policy changes.
findings.details: S04-T04 requires admins to bulk-select joined channels and set explicit routing and delivery policies. The route now renders checkboxes, radio buttons, an allowlist input, and an Apply button, but all of them are uncontrolled static elements backed by localChannelPolicyFixture. There is no selected-channel state, no policy input state, no submit handler, and no Confect mutation/ref wiring to bulkSetChannelPolicies, so an admin cannot actually apply the accepted bulk change from the UI. The focused web tests only assert pure view-model metadata and do not render/prove the interactive Connections control-plane behavior, making the web gate a false green for the UI requirement.
